title: Maximum Font Size to Fit in Screen
description: Find the largest font size such that a given string fits within a screen of dimensions width x height.
pseudocode:
1. low = minFontSize, high = maxFontSize
2. while low <= high:
3.   mid = (low + high) / 2
4.   if canFit(mid): result = mid, low = mid + 1
5.   else: high = mid - 1
6. return result

steps.note: Initialize binary search range with low=1, high=20.
Check if font size 10 fits. It fits, store 10, search higher range [11, 20].
Check if font size 15 fits. It does not fit, search lower range [11, 14].
Check if font size 12 fits. It fits, store 12, search higher range [13, 14].
